description: DEF CON 33 Cloud Village talks covering cloud security offense and defense across AWS, Azure, GCP, and Kubernetes environments.

talks.title: No Server, No Cry: the Ups and Downs of Building a Scalable Security Serverless Platform
talks.teaser: Lessons from building a scalable security platform on serverless cloud infrastructure.

talks.title: Identity Crisis: The Unmanaged World of Azure Managed Identities - Alon Klayman and Eliraz Levi
talks.teaser: Exposing the hidden risks of Azure Managed Identities and how attackers exploit unmanaged identities.

talks.title: Auths Gone Wild: When ‘Authenticated’ Means Anyone
talks.teaser: How misconfigured authentication allows unauthenticated access to cloud resources.

talks.title: Transforming Identity Protection: Innovating with AI and Attack Paths
talks.teaser: Combining AI and attack-path analysis to transform cloud identity protection.

talks.title: No IP, No Problem: Exfiltrating Data Behind IAP
talks.teaser: Exfiltrating cloud data from behind Google Identity-Aware Proxy without a public IP.

talks.title: Command and KubeCTL: Kubernetes Security for Pentesters and Defenders
talks.teaser: Practical Kubernetes security techniques for both offensive and defensive practitioners.

talks.title: May the Least Privilege Be With You
talks.teaser: Implementing and enforcing least-privilege IAM policies across cloud environments.

talks.title: Hypervisor Hangover: Persistence Mechanisms on ESXi - JC(Crashwire) and Nathan
talks.teaser: Novel ESXi hypervisor persistence techniques for maintaining long-term access in cloud environments.

talks.title: Weaponizing SageMaker AI: Real-World Offense in Machine Learning Platforms
talks.teaser: Exploiting AWS SageMaker to gain persistence and exfiltrate data from ML platforms.

talks.title: Exploring The Possibilities of Azure Fabric Abuses
talks.teaser: Attack surface analysis and abuse possibilities of Microsoft Azure Fabric services.

talks.title: Uncovering Hidden Threats: The Risks of Dangling Issuers in Federated Credentials
talks.teaser: Dangling issuer vulnerabilities in federated cloud credentials and how to exploit them.

talks.title: Restless Guests: From Subscription to Backdoor Intruder
talks.teaser: Turning Azure subscription access into persistent backdoor access across tenants.

talks.title: TencentGoat: An Intentionally Vulnerable Tencent Cloud Environment
talks.teaser: TencentGoat: an intentionally vulnerable Tencent Cloud environment for hands-on cloud security training.

talks.title: SquarePhish 2.0 - Turning QR Codes into Entra ID Primary Refresh Tokens
talks.teaser: Evolving SquarePhish to weaponize QR codes for Entra ID Primary Refresh Token extraction.

talks.title: Sweet Deception: Designing Effective M365 Honey Tokens
talks.teaser: Designing effective honey tokens in Microsoft 365 to detect and attribute cloud intrusions.

talks.title: Building the Cross-Cloud Kill Chain: A DE's Playbook for AWS, Azure & GCP Detections
talks.teaser: Building cross-cloud kill chain detections for AWS, Azure, and GCP attacks.

talks.title: Spotter - Universal Kubernetes Security Engine
talks.teaser: Spotter: a universal Kubernetes security engine for automated runtime threat detection.

talks.title: Threat Modelling at Scale: Breaking Down Cloud Complexity
talks.teaser: Scaling threat modeling to handle the complexity of modern multi-cloud architectures.

talks.title: whoAMI: Discovering and exploiting a large-scale AMI name confusion attack
talks.teaser: Discovering and exploiting large-scale AMI name confusion attacks across the AWS ecosystem.

talks.title: Quickstart for a Breach! When Official Installations Expose Your K8 and Your Cloud
talks.teaser: How official cloud installation scripts expose Kubernetes clusters and cloud environments to breach.

talks.title: Cognito, Ergo Some Extra Permissions
talks.teaser: Exploiting AWS Cognito misconfigurations to achieve privilege escalation and account takeover.

talks.title: Weaponizing SSM: Practical Exploits and Hardening Techniques for AWS
talks.teaser: Weaponizing AWS Systems Manager for lateral movement and hardening techniques for defenders.

talks.title: Don't trust Rufus, he's a mole - introducing KIEMPossible
talks.teaser: KIEMPossible: exploiting KIEM (Key Identity and Execution Manager) weaknesses in Azure environments.

talks.title: Braving the Storm-2372: The Tempest Decoded
talks.teaser: Decoding the Storm-2372 threat actor campaign targeting cloud and identity infrastructure.
